top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 chain from proglucagon processing and identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, through glucose-dependent insulin secretion and effects on appetite and gastric emptying, to therapies validated in large outcome trials is complete, replicated and mature. P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards the physiology and the active form that defined what any drug had to imitate, with a citation that also names the therapeutic consequence. P002 swaps Mojsov for Knudsen and is a legitimate but narrower, drug-development-centred allocation, so it ranks second; no award is clearly worse given the maturity of the field.
